title: The Mirage of Calibrated Confidence: Trajectory-Independence of Verbalized Confidence in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.18453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A calibrated Vision-Language Model (VLM) can repeatedly self-correct, say "Wait, I should recheck," arrive at the wrong answer, and still report high confidence. We find that this occurs because verbalized confidence is largely trajectory-independent in the VLMs and calibration methods we evaluate. We examine this through three complementary lenses: content variation, token masking, and the model's own hesitation markers. We show that confidence is insufficiently sensitive to what the reasoning trajectory actually contains, and that calibration training can paradoxically worsen this disconnect. Since existing metrics like ECE and AUROC cannot detect this problem, we propose the Trajectory-Grounding Score (TGS) in two complementary forms: TGS-self, which compares confidence with and without access to the model's own trajectory, and TGS-pair, which tests whether the model assigns higher confidence to correct trajectories than to flawed one

translated_title: 校准置信度的幻象：视觉-语言模型中言语化置信度的轨迹独立性
translated_abstract: 一个经过校准的视觉-语言模型（VLM）可以反复自我纠正，说“等等，我应该重新检查”，最终得出错误的答案，却仍然报告高置信度。我们发现，这是因为在我们所评估的VLM和校准方法中，言语化置信度在很大程度上与轨迹无关。我们通过三个互补的视角来考察这一现象：内容变化、token掩码以及模型自身的犹豫标记。我们表明，置信度对推理轨迹实际包含的内容不够敏感，而校准训练反而可能矛盾地加剧这种脱节。由于现有的ECE和AUROC等指标无法检测到这一问题，我们提出了轨迹接地分数（TGS）的两种互补形式：TGS-self，比较模型在有和没有访问自身轨迹情况下的置信度；TGS-pair，测试模型是否对正确轨迹赋予比有缺陷轨迹更高的置信度。
tldr: 该论文揭示了视觉-语言模型的言语化置信度与推理轨迹基本脱钩（即使自我纠正后得出错误答案仍报告高置信度），并提出新指标轨迹接地分数（TGS）来检测现有ECE和AUROC指标无法识别的这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that verbalized confidence in Vision-Language Models is largely trajectory-independent—models can self-correct, arrive at wrong answers, and still report high confidence—and proposes the Trajectory-Grounding Score (TGS) to detect this disconnect that existing metrics like ECE and AUROC fail to capture.
